{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders

    (df['status'] == 'completed') &
    (df['revenue'] != 999999.99) &
    (df['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search']))
]

# Check the filtered population
df_clean.shape"}
